name: dogfood-ably-collab-cursor
description: Dogfood app 2 (v1.13-4) — an Ably shared cursor + broadcast + history rewind app that exercises high-frequency cursor position broadcast, client-side 60fps throttle, and history rewind (channel.history) across a provider-neutral interface, drivable in both KIWA_MODE=real (calls ably when ABLY_API_KEY is set) and KIWA_MODE=mock (@kiwa-test/realtime createAblyMock) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-test/quality-metrics 7-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-test/realtime -F @kiwa-test/core -F @kiwa-test/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
